FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 286
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Marcus Paramore
Government
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/17/2025
House Bill 286 as introduced would require purchases of supplies and services by volunteer fire
departments and rescue squads to be governed by current state law governing other local
government units. This bill would not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
